verdict.rationale: PostHog's feature-flag docs explicitly list scheduling flag changes as a capability, both in the UI and from MCP clients. The evidence is only brief one-line mentions and gives no detail on setting a specific future time or which changes can be scheduled. Missing for 10: documentation of time-specific scheduling mechanics, explicit scheduling of releases or rollout changes beyond the generic phrase, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule flag changes and releases to happen at a specific future time

citations.quote: Create flags, set release conditions, schedule changes, and watch rollouts land.
Create, update, schedule, and clean up flags from any MCP client or AI editor.
